## ActionControl

- Source: `packages/client/ui-layout/src/client/spatial/primitives/components.tsx` (`ActionControl`)
- Import: `packages/client/ui-layout/src/client/spatial/primitives/index.ts`
- Purpose: An ordinary action in place: a native button (or, with `href`, a link) in the tone's outline, for an app's own controls (a mode switch, a settings toggle, a disabled Generate). Its look is a zero-specificity floor the app refines.
